description: Discover Iowa State Senator Molly Donahue’s dedication to strengthening Iowa’s communities. With over six years of legislative experience, Molly champions education, healthcare access, economic growth, and environmental protections. Explore her bold advocacy for rural Iowans, families, and veterans, and stay updated on her work for District 3 through in-depth issue discussions, newsletters, and daily updates on Facebook. Compassion, integrity, and action for a brighter Iowa future.
title: HOME | Molly Donahue
